name: espack
description: ESPACK - self-extracting single-file ExternalObject bundles for ExtendScript (ES3). At build time a DLL is embedded as base64 inside a .jsx; at runtime the JSX unpacks itself (chunked decode via the inlined esb64 atob lane), materializes the DLL into a per-user cache dir, loads it via ExternalObject, and switches a consumer library from its ES3 fallback to the native accelerated implementation.

scripts.test: node tests/espack-test.mjs && node tests/espack-merge-test.mjs && node tests/vendor-sync-test.mjs
